title: fix: remove incorrect special handling of :export pseudo-selectors
body: #18793 added special handling for `:export` selectors, but this is incorrect. `:export` is (apparently) part of [Interoperable CSS](https://github.com/css-modules/icss) but Svelte doesn't (and shouldn't) know what that is. No changeset because #18793 is unreleased, and the changeset in that PR didn't mention ICSS
